illustration.description: Four translucent glowing anatomical human figures standing in side profile on a plain white background, arranged left to right in a progression from poor to good posture. The first figure on the left is pale peach/orange, slouched with a rounded upper back, head jutting forward and downward, glowing spine visible. The second is warm amber-yellow, slightly less slouched, head more upright. The third is deep orange, nearly upright with a straighter spine. The fourth on the right is bright lime-green, fully upright with a tall straight posture, head level, glowing spine visible through translucent skin. Soft luminous rim lighting, smooth 3D medical-illustration style, subtle inner glow, clean studio lighting, minimal shadows, neutral white background.
